GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jumped away awkwardly. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd 3 Wide until worked to lead on inside early . Held lead on inside midrace until joined in front @ 550m. Pushed to quicken =lead Two Wide on home turn. Weakened Two Wide in straight. Rider - needs more give in the ground. # Led & tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Momentarily steadied from heels near 200m. App stated inst to have mount begin well & settle where comfortable. App stated mount wide in early stages & when leaders showing no intent to hold lead she allowed mount to stride fwd. App stated mount ran wide rounding 1st turn & had to work harder than anticipated to obtain lead near 1200m. App stated after working hard early mount could not sustain finishing effort. Tnr agreed. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to joint Lead on fence, sole Lead from the first turn, Held Together in front, led 1 length turning, stayed close to rail in straight and headed 75m from post # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Led the event under minimal pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( winkers off, Tongue Tie again ) Jumped Well from a low draw. Settled Down on rail 4th 3 Lengths @ 1200m. Ridden Along Straightening Up all Clear . Kept Finding line getting weight from all others # Boxed On Evenly
began ok 3wide turn went back 1200m 3rd last Wide 6len 600m Hooked Out up no run on # Wide went back av
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Passing the winning post on the first occasion, whilst being restrained in an effort to obtain cover, was further steadied to avoid heels. Raced three wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: began ok but got squeezed out a bit and then went back Settled Down Two Wide at tail, about 12 Lengths ? Clear last To The Turn but more like 8L. railed then off rail Straight Just Held Ground although was going ok Through line # never any threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded. Had difficulty obtaining clear running during the early part of the home straight and near the 100m was steadied after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & chased honestly in straight. # Wide/stuck on OK
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start, was bumped by another runner which shifted out. Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 5 lengths. very Wide turn under pressure. dropped out # Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin.  Raced wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair eased near last 7l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 3l off, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 900m, had to be checked when awkwardly placed near heels. Raced wide and with cover throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (7L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed out 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Five Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Out Six Wide @ 300m & held up Six Wide @ 250m. Held up nearly all the way in the last 200m. # Never got a crack.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Held up for clear running from near the 300m until inside the 100m.
